notes.title: Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow | Update #3
notes.content:
Hello daydreamers,

Here's Update #3, so soon! 

[h2][b]CHAPTER 1[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] (Father's study) added a moving lamp above the head of the animal;
[*] Added tips in the form of bars under the animal pictures with the years;
[*] Fixed a bug with the camera, if you reload, you move on the axes of XY - the movement should be on the camera axes;
[*] (Mother's room) Griffin cannot die falling from a height;
[*] The room with the ventilator (the problematic one) - you can't die after falling from a height.
[/list]

[h2][b]CHAPTER 2[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added illumination on the place where the bear is hanging in the cobweb (where you have to go up after the torch goes out);
[*] Additional save line was added in the same place;
[*] In front of the fishing line a save line was added;
[*] Because of the change of speed Griffin can run away from the spider after the puzzle with the trap (where there is still a flower);
[*] In the place where you have to lead the spider in the cage (puzzle with levers) Griffin cannot fall down if you get up and go to the left;
[*] Removed beams from the floor that looked like a prohibition to move down;
[*] Changed the camera at the end of the escape from the grease where you have to jump on a hook.
[/list]

[h3][h2][b]OUTSIDE THE MILL[/b][/h2][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the camera on the right side from the bottom;
[*] In the whole chapter you go right to left in the XY of the chamber;
[*] Added a new spinning platform to jump on;
[*] The flatbed with the bike is now a little lower than before;
[*] Changed the collision of the bag of hay on which you need to climb.
[/list]

[h2][b]THE CHAPTER WITH MIRA[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] On places where there are stairs to safely descend - you cannot die if you jump (2 places);
[*] If you fall from the crane, you cannot die.
[/list]

[h2][b]THE FACTORY[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] You can't die when falling from the robot's head;
[*] You can't die if you fall from the puzzle (from the crane) located on top of the house (after the puzzle with the gear wheel, which must be melted down).
[/list]

Thanks for the feedback, dear daydreamers! It really helps to make Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow better!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542110/Daydream_Forgotten_Sorrow 

[h2][b]About the game[/b][/h2]
[b]Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow[/b] stars a boy named Griffin as he embarks on a journey to face his fears alongside his teddy bear companion Birly. As Griffin learns to confront haunting memories amidst floating castles and enchanted forests, he’ll come to discover the mystery of this newfound world.

[h3][b]Key Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] A touching story made for everyone
[*] Command an adorable teddy bear companion
[*] Intelligent puzzles
[*] A charming and mysterious universe
[*] Unbridled (and sometimes scary!) fantasy fun
[/list]
[h2]Find [b]Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow[/b] on social media:[/h2]
► [url=https://twitter.com/day_dream_game]Twitter[/url]
► [url=https://discord.gg/zap9pZ4k8k]Discord[/url]
► [url=http://www.tiktok.com/@daydreamgame]TikTok[/url] 
► [url=https://www.instagram.com/daydreamgame/]Instagram[/url]

Thank you for your support and for being with us all these days! Enjoy the game! 🧸

notes.title: Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow | Update #1
notes.content:
Hello dreamers!

It's been a while, and we're excited to share our first update. Here's what we've improved:

[h3][b]Better Camera Review[/b][/h3]
We've made significant improvements to the camera review, resulting in higher quality and clearer visuals. Capturing moments is now more satisfying than ever.

[h3][b]Simplified Challenging Areas[/b][/h3]
We've streamlined some of the difficult and hard-to-navigate sections, making gameplay smoother. Now, players can progress through these once tough obstacles with ease, ensuring a more enjoyable and seamless journey.

[h3][b]Enhanced AI Characters[/b][/h3]
We've given Birly and Mira, our lovely characters, notable enhancements. The AI has been refined, bringing more depth and realism to these lovable characters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542110/Daydream_Forgotten_Sorrow

notes.title: Steam Patchnote - New Demo
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends! 👋

Thanks to your feedback, we have made several improvements to our demo. Here is the list of changes we are ready to present in today’s update.

[h3][b]🧑‍🦰Updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New objects - the world now feels more alive, and we finally have the pigeons!
[*] New Griffin and Birly interaction animations, we all deserve that display of friendship!
[*] We added a visual effect for confirming commands.
[*] We also added cues for controls, now you’ll always know that shift is for running!
[/list]
[h3][b]🧸Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We improved overall performance on locations.
[*] We also improved collision and collider models. If you were frightened by Birly stuck in the wall, he won’t do that again!
[*] Reworked lighting and shadows.
[*] Reworked the environment.
[*] Reworked the camera in cutscenes.
[*] Reworked the UI design.
[*] Reworked environmental sounds.
[*] Improved old animations.
[*] Improved companion AI.
[*] Improved item physics.
[/list]
❤️ Thanks for your continuous support, I hope you enjoy the new version of the demo!

Remember to wishlist [b]Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow[/b] in case you still haven’t done it. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542110/Daydream_Forgotten_Sorrow/ 

You can also follow us on social media to receive more news and updates!
